title: Canadian Biscuits Bake
description: A classic Canadian treat, these biscuits are perfect for a warm breakfast or snack. They're easy to make and always a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together butter, eggs, and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
